mapper.insert: insert into clazz (name, room, begin_date, end_date, subject, master_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{room}, #{beginDate}, #{endDate}, #{subject}, #{masterId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update:
update clazz
name = #{name},
room = #{room},
begin_date = #{beginDate},
end_date = #{endDate},
subject = #{subject},
master_id = #{masterId},
update_time = #{updateTime},
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select t1.id, t1.name, t1.room, t1.begin_date, t1.end_date, t1.subject, t1.master_id from clazz t1 left join emp t2 on t1.master_id = t2.id where t1.id = #{id}
